description_ru: Автор рассказывает, почему велосипед лучше машины в городе.
text:
Last year, I stopped driving to work and bought a bicycle. Now I think everybody in the city should try it.

First, cycling is faster than driving. In the morning, the traffic is terrible. Cars stand in long lines for twenty minutes, but I ride past them and arrive in fifteen minutes.

Second, it is healthier. I do not have time for the gym, but every day I exercise on the way to work. I feel stronger and more awake than before.

Third, it is cheaper. A bicycle does not need petrol, and parking is free. I saved a lot of money this year.

Of course, cycling is not perfect. When it rains, you get wet, and in winter it is cold. Sometimes drivers are not careful, so I always wear a helmet. But I believe that the good things are more important than the bad things.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Нижняя губа слегка касается верхних зубов, звук звонкий; не превращайте «v» в русское «в» двумя губами.
Кончик языка поднят к нёбу, но не касается его и не вибрирует; губы чуть округлены.
Поставьте кончик языка между зубами и выдохните без голоса; не заменяйте звук на «с» или «ф».
Начните с «а» и плавно уйдите к короткому «и»; не говорите просто «ай» с твёрдым «й».

questions.question: How did the writer go to work before?
How long does the journey take by bicycle?
Why is cycling cheaper?
questions.answer: It does not need petrol and parking is free.
